events.summary: A strike hit a family compound in Kuhestak where a wedding gathering was underway, killing civilians and wounding more than 60. U.S.-munition evidence and U.S. operations strongly support U.S. culpability; intent to target civilians is not established.
events.adjudication_note: Civilian casualty count and attribution should remain revisionable; deliberate-targeting intent is a separate proposition.

events.summary: Reuters reported that Iran warned against a full Israeli offensive on Ali al-Taher and that officials described IRGC personnel with Hezbollah there; the White House disputed the account and Reuters could not independently confirm the military situation.
events.adjudication_note: Classification is MULTISOURCE REPORTED / CONTESTED / NOT INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED. Do not promote reported IRGC presence to confirmed.

events.summary: Israel said it cleared Hezbollah fighters and tunnels at the Ali al-Taher ridge; a Lebanese military official gave a more qualified account and Hezbollah did not comment.
events.adjudication_note: Do not convert Israeli operational-control claims into proof every tunnel or fighter was eliminated.

events.summary: The United States, United Kingdom, France and Germany pushed an IAEA Board resolution that could report Iran to the U.N. Security Council amid unresolved safeguards/access issues.
events.adjudication_note: Policy/diplomatic escalation; not evidence that Iran possesses a nuclear weapon.

events.summary: Treasury sanctioned Golden Global Bank and subsidiaries in Türkiye as part of Operation Economic Outcast, alleging facilitation of IRGC-QF and Iranian financial activity.
events.adjudication_note: The enforcement action is fact; Treasury's allegations are actor claims and the bank disputed them.

events.summary: Fighting intensified around Taiz and terrain affecting the Taiz-Mokha supply route, raising Bab el-Mandeb leverage concerns.
events.adjudication_note: A Houthi objective to seize/control Bab el-Mandeb remains an assessment, not an achieved fact; no Tehran operational order is inferred.

record.observed_state: Reuters/Kpler reporting supports a fall from roughly 1.7-2.0 million bpd pre-blockade/earlier in 2026 to roughly 220,000-260,000 bpd in August.
record.note: Provider/day/AIS-dark definitions matter. Do not turn a severe contraction into universal zero.

record.observed_traffic: Four Kpler-tracked commodity vessels crossed Thursday; prior day nine; 10-day average about 15; prewar large-commercial-vessel traffic about 125/day.
record.note: Neither binary 'fully open' nor 'nothing can pass' accurately describes the observed state.
Operation Economic Outcast has entered active enforcement; realized effects remain an ongoing measurement question.
Severe contraction is established; literal universal zero and exact AIS-dark/day/provider volumes remain unresolved.
